map.依据 GB 28050，输入每100g食品中营养成分含量，自动计算NRV%并生成: Per GB 28050, enter the nutrient content per 100 g of a food and it computes NRV% and generates a nutrition label.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：val×servingSize÷100；(val÷n: Core formulas (by input variables): val×servingSize÷100; (val÷nrv.nrv)×100; min(100, n.nrvPct)

map.📚 深度解析：营养标签 NRV% 计算: 📚 Deep Dive: Nutrition Label NRV% Calculation
map.NRV% = 每 100g 含量 ÷ NRV 参考值 ×100%（能量 2000: NRV% = content per 100 g ÷ NRV reference value × 100% (energy 2000 kJ, protein 60 g, fat 60 g, carbohydrate 300 g, sugars 50 g, sodium 2000 mg and so on).
map.每 100 g：能量 800 kJ、蛋白 5 g、脂肪 10 g、碳水 60 g: Per 100 g: energy 800 kJ, protein 5 g, fat 10 g, carbohydrate 60 g, sugars 15 g gives NRV% of 40%, 8%, 17%, 20% and 30% respectively; saturated fat 3 g gives 15%.
map.NRV 参考值哪来？: Where do the NRV reference values come from?
map.按 GB 28050 附录，能量 2000 kJ、各营养素有固定参考值，标签须标: From the annex of GB 28050: energy 2000 kJ with fixed reference values for each nutrient, and labels must state NRV%.
map.低/无声称怎么用？: How are low or free claims used?
map.按含量阈值（如糖≤5 g/100g 可称「低糖」）组合 NRV% 标示，避免误导: Combine the content thresholds (for example, sugars of 5 g or less per 100 g may be called low sugar) with the NRV% statement, and avoid misleading claims.
